revisions.name: 經驗增加
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise this existing game ability icon for Experience Boost. Keep the bold five-point star and strong upward upgrade arrow idea. Recompose the middle into a broad clean readable area containing EXACT uppercase text EXP, spelled E X P, once only. EXP must be large, heavy geometric sans serif stencil cutouts across the star/arrow center, readable at small HUD size, no other letters or numerals. It must instantly communicate experience gain. Preserve a strong cohesive silhouette with generous gaps. Remove the old thin lower crack if it makes EXP harder to read. This is a game HUD icon, not an illustration.
Final shared style: ONE standalone square transparent PNG icon. Pure flat opaque white geometric artwork on a genuinely transparent background. Maintain the existing family of minimalist FPS ability HUD pictograms, chunky readable shapes, consistent bold visual weight and centered balanced margins. CRITICAL: completely clean smooth vector-like edges and EMPTY transparent negative spaces. Remove all speckles, distressed/grunge texture, debris, fine contour sketch lines, gradients, soft shadows and glow from the source. No black filled background, no color, no tile, no decorative background. Sharp large simple cutouts, not hairline details. Approximately 76 percent canvas occupancy; never crop artwork.
